name: Ethiopia

flag.description: Three horizontal stripes of green, yellow and red, with a blue disc in the centre bearing a yellow five-pointed star with rays between its points.
flag.symbolism: Green stands for the land and fertility, yellow for hope and peace, and red for strength and sacrifice; the star on the blue disc represents the unity and equality of the nation's peoples.

hook: Ethiopia gave Africa its green-yellow-red; its own flag adds a blue disc with a golden star, which Bolivia's and Lithuania's stripes lack.
trivia: Because Ethiopia avoided colonisation, its green, yellow and red were taken up by many newly independent African states as the pan-African colours.
Ethiopia uses its own calendar of 13 months, which runs about seven to eight years behind the Gregorian calendar.
